headline: A 1-for-5 night
record_line: Yesterday: 1-3 on the top plays · Season: 36-143

entries.headline: Manny Machado did not appear
entries.story: Manny Machado was scratched or never got in the game, so the pick carries over as a no-action.

entries.headline: Fernando Tatis Jr. stayed in the yard
entries.story: Fernando Tatis Jr. went 2-for-4 with 1 RBI against Brandon Williamson and the Cincinnati Reds. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Hunter Goodman came close
entries.story: Hunter Goodman went 1-for-5 against Trevor Rogers and the Baltimore Orioles. Closest call was a double in the 4th: "Hunter Goodman doubles (18) on a sharp line drive to left fielder Luis Robert Jr." The power showed up; the carry did not.

entries.headline: Kyle Schwarber stayed in the yard
entries.story: Kyle Schwarber went 0-for-4 against Taylor Clarke and the Arizona Diamondbacks. No real scare on the HR front, striking out 2 times.

entries.headline: Rafael Devers connected at +400
entries.story: Rafael Devers cashed. Facing Bubba Chandler, he went deep in the 1st in his 1st at bat. The call: "Rafael Devers homers (32) on a fly ball to center field." Final line: 2-for-3 with 2 BB.
